# Retained 173 challenge entry

`boards-zero-of-three.png` is the byte-original last observation from standard-theme Request4 in 2.9.173, before RECON input. It visibly reads Boards cleared0/3. The reported entry failed because the complete-word fallback selected only the first literal Boards reference for its background mask. The existing Boards-three reference already contains the weak letter fringe at(878,63).

The regression uses all existing native Boards reference supports inside the independently recognised complete word spans. It retains label tolerance9, blue floor6, complete letter cores/shape distances, banner geometry, counter parsing and true background checks. No new recognition bank is calibrated from this image.

`calibration.json` records the original SHA256 and explicit evidence limits. Mutated negatives in tests are synthetic. Offline tests do not prove fresh guest acceptance.
